title: Overlap compatibility annihilates the simultaneous local quotient map
statement: With localSubobjectQuotientMap α [def-weil-pbc-proetale-local-subobject-kernel] formed from maps q_i:L_i→Q|Ui over a pro-etale cover U [def-weil-pbc-proetale-covering], suppose that on every Ui×XUj the underlying local sheaves are isomorphic by c_ij commuting with q_i, q_j and upperStarCompIso. Then q_i≫(U_i→X)^*α=0 for every i, without a monicity hypothesis. This asserts only vanishing of the obstruction map on an already specified local subobject.

source.place: Tag 04TR, effective gluing of sheaves, expressed for subobjects

proof.text: Identify weakly etale inverse image with localization restriction. It preserves products, so it is enough to check each local quotient component.

On Ui×XUj, compatibility identifies the pullback of q_i with the pullback of q_j; compose with the pullback of cokernel.π(q_j) to get zero. Weakly etale base change and adjunction identify this with q_i followed by the restriction of the j-th component of α, including the stipulated upperStarCompIso. Prove the compatibility of the two mates of the square using iterated_mateEquiv_conjugateEquiv and conjugateEquiv_comp. The unit_mateEquiv equation and naturality transpose the overlap zero equation. Thus each component, and hence the product map, vanishes. Apply the existing source-library weakly-etale base-change theorem directly, using its squareLowerStarIso; the canonical coefficient implementation is shared by the compatibility imports.

lean.statement:
theorem localSubobjectQuotientMap_zero_of_compatible
    (X : Scheme.{u}) (Q : Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology X) Ab.{u + 1})
    (U : Scheme.Cover.{u} Scheme.proetalePrecoverage X)
    (L : ∀ i, Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology (U.X i)) Ab.{u + 1})
    (q : ∀ i, L i ⟶ (upperStar Ab.{u + 1} (U.f i)).obj Q)
    (hcompatible : ∀ i j, ∃ c :
      (upperStar Ab.{u + 1} (pullback.fst (U.f i) (U.f j))).obj (L i) ≅
        (upperStar Ab.{u + 1} (pullback.snd (U.f i) (U.f j))).obj (L j),
      c.hom ≫ (upperStar Ab.{u + 1} (pullback.snd (U.f i) (U.f j))).map (q j) =
        (upperStar Ab.{u + 1} (pullback.fst (U.f i) (U.f j))).map (q i) ≫
          (upperStarCompIso Ab.{u + 1}
            (pullback.condition (f := U.f i) (g := U.f j))).hom.app Q) :
    ∀ i, q i ≫ (upperStar Ab.{u + 1} (U.f i)).map
      (localSubobjectQuotientMap X Q U L q) = 0
